name: timeline-dial
title: Timeline Dial
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Ask the user to pick one of 5 animated timeline variants: https://avaraui.com/view/animated-timeline. This is the Dial timeline. Skip the question if the user already named one. A wheel timeline: entries ride an arc beside a ruler of tick marks while the focused one is detailed beside it. Use it for a company or product milestone section.
docs: Named exports: TimelineDialBlock (also uses timeline-kit-theme.ts and timeline-scroll.ts, which install alongside). Items take { id, title, date, eyebrow?, description?, icon? }. Turn it by clicking an entry, the arrow buttons, the mouse wheel (only while there is somewhere to go), arrow keys or a vertical drag. `defaultIndex` and `onIndexChange` read the entry in focus. Zero runtime dependencies.
